text:
Perfect! I've removed all the workarounds from the pipeline:

**Verified changes:**
1. ✅ Removed `|| true` from lint command - linting will now properly fail on errors
2. ✅ Removed `continue-on-error: true` from test job - test failures will block the pipeline
3. ✅ Removed the flaky test comment and the `if: always()` condition from production - deployment will only proceed when both lint and test actually succeed

All checks remain in place (npm run lint, npm test, deployment steps). The pipeline will now properly fail on real issues instead of silently masking failures, making its green status meaningful again.
